items.title: Translate a staff request
items.instructions: Translate the polite request into English.

payload.source_text: Xin lỗi, anh/chị có thể giúp tôi kiểm tra giờ khởi hành được không?
payload.intended_meaning: A respectful request to unfamiliar staff to check a departure time.
payload.primary_answer: Excuse me, could you help me check the departure time?
acceptable_variants: Excuse me, could you help me check the departure time?
payload.scoring_guidance: Require an attention-getter and a polite could-you-help request.

items.title: Match requests to situations
items.instructions: Match each request to the person and situation it best suits.

right.text: Can you look at this map with me?
Excuse me, could you help me check this platform, please?

payload.explanation: The fuller request suits unfamiliar staff; the shorter shared-task request suits a friend.

items.title: Sequence information mediation
items.instructions: Order the steps for passing reliable station information to a friend.

segments.text: Tell your friend the confirmed facts.
Confirm an unclear detail with staff.

payload.explanation: Read first, confirm uncertainty next, and relay the checked facts last.

items.title: Choose a polite request
items.instructions: Choose the most polite request for unfamiliar station staff.

options.text: Excuse me, could you help me find Gate 7, please?

payload.explanation: Option b uses an attention-getter, could you help me, and please for a respectful request to unfamiliar staff.

items.title: Write a checked message
items.instructions: Write a message that passes all facts in the notice to a friend.

payload.communicative_goal: Relay a departure number, time, and location accurately.
constraints: Use this original notice: Coach 9 leaves at 14:10 from Bay C.
payload.expected_output: A concise message preserving Coach 9, 14:10, and Bay C.

rubric.criterion: All three facts match the notice.
The friend can act on the message without seeing the notice.
